description: The VisualTheme class defines a theme for widgets within the OFBiz framework, encapsulating properties such as theme ID, display name, description, and screenshots. It provides methods for initializing from XML, expanding display properties via string expanders, and retrieving associated model data.

classes.name: VisualTheme
classes.description: Represents a visual theme in the OFBiz system, encapsulating theme properties and XML-based initialization.

methods.name: getVisualThemeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the visual theme.

methods.name: getScreenshots
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of screenshot locations for the theme.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Expands and returns the localized display name using the provided context.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Expands and returns the description of the theme based on the given context.

methods.name: VisualTheme
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the VisualTheme object from an XML Element, extracting attributes and child elements.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the VisualTheme object including id, display-name, description, and screenshots.
